author: Nigel_Farage
text:
The next election will be an existential fight to save the country we love, a mission I have now been fighting for over 30 years.

After two national election victories in as many years, many people now recognise that it will be a binary choice between Reform UK and Labour.

With the prospect of an early general election increasingly likely, it is natural that people from across the political spectrum are considering which side of that fight they intend to be on. Patriotic voters believe in many of the same things, but only one party truly has the possibility of delivering change.

To deliver that change, I understand Reform UK will need the support of people from other parties, as well as millions who have never voted before. That is the broad coalition I am building.
